source: Qloo Taste AI (https://hackathon.api.qloo.com) — Singapore senior taste fixtures for offline tests and fallback

places.name: Toa Payoh Lorong 8 Teochew Steamed Fish & Kopi O Corner
places.name_zh: 大巴窑8巷潮州清蒸鱼与咖啡乌角
places.why_en: Qloo links Nanyang kopi, mahjong kakis and 1970s Hokkien/Teochew classics with traditional Teochew steamed fish and kopi-O kosong stalls.
places.why_zh: Qloo 品味图谱将南洋咖啡、麻将老友与70年代闽南金曲，关联到清淡少盐的潮州清蒸鱼和咖啡乌少糖档口。

places.name: Bishan-Ang Mo Kio Sheltered Tea Pavilion & Chess Corner
places.name_zh: 碧山-宏茂桥有盖茶亭与棋友角
places.why_en: Sheltered community pavilion popular with central-heartland seniors who enjoy tile games, Chinese tea and unhurried morning chats.
places.why_zh: 有盖社区茶亭，适合喜欢牌友聚会、清茶与邻里闲聊的长者。

places.name: Toa Payoh Town Park Fragrant Herb & Pond Walk
places.name_zh: 大巴窑市镇公园香草与池畔步道
places.why_en: Flat, shaded lakeside path with pandan and lemongrass plots; a gentle morning stroll when the air is clear.
places.why_zh: 平坦阴凉的池畔步道，种有斑兰与香茅，空气好时适合晨间慢走。

places.name: Yuhua Market Heritage Chinese Tea & Nanyang Song Corner
places.name_zh: 裕华巴刹传统茶座与南洋老歌角
places.why_en: Qloo connects Teresa Teng and Frances Yip fans in Jurong with heritage tea stalls where regulars hum 1970s Mandopop and Cantopop classics.
places.why_zh: Qloo 将邓丽君、叶丽仪的歌迷与裕华巴刹传统茶座关联，街坊常在此哼唱70年代华语与粤语经典。

places.name: Taman Jurong Warung Kopi O Kosong & Ikan Bakar
places.name_zh: 达曼裕廊传统无糖咖啡乌与烤鱼档
places.why_en: Qloo pairs P. Ramlee and Nusantara folk taste profiles with traditional Malay warungs serving plain kopi-O kosong and lightly spiced grilled fish without heavy sweet gravy.
places.why_zh: Qloo 将比·南利经典音乐品味与传统马来咖啡档关联，提供无糖咖啡乌与清淡烤鱼。

places.name: Woodlands-Marsiling Sheltered Orchid Conservatory & Kopi Corner
places.name_zh: 兀兰-马西岭有盖胡姬花温室与咖啡角
places.why_en: Qloo links orchid and herb gardening enthusiasts with sheltered community glasshouses and quiet morning kopi corners.
places.why_zh: Qloo 将喜爱园艺与60年代怀旧金曲的长者，关联到有盖胡姬花温室与晨间咖啡角。

places.name: Jurong Lake Gardens Therapeutic HortPark Walk
places.name_zh: 裕廊湖花园疗愈园艺步道
places.why_en: Wheelchair- and senior-friendly garden loop with raised herb beds along Jurong Lake.
places.why_zh: 裕廊湖畔平坦无障碍的园艺步道，设有高架香草花圃。

places.name: Tampines Round Market Fresh Thosai & Masala Ginger Tea Stall
places.name_zh: 淡滨尼圆巴刹现烙印度薄饼与姜茶档
places.why_en: Qloo connects South Asian classical and folk music profiles with Tampines Round Market's morning thosai and unsweetened ginger tea circle.
places.why_zh: Qloo 将南亚经典音乐与养生品味，关联到淡滨尼圆巴刹清晨的少盐薄饼与无糖姜茶聚脚处。

places.name: Bedok Interchange Traditional Kopi O & Soft-Boiled Eggs Corner
places.name_zh: 勿洛转换站传统咖啡乌与半熟蛋角
places.why_en: Qloo links East-side kopi and craft-circle tastes with Bedok's breezy indoor hawker tables where regulars chat over kopi-O siew dai.
places.why_zh: Qloo 将东部长者的咖啡与手工聚会偏好，关联到勿洛室内熟食中心的少糖咖啡乌茶座。

places.name: Our Tampines Hub Sheltered Sky Terrace & Evergreen Lounge
places.name_zh: 淡滨尼天地有盖空中花园与常青音乐廊
places.why_en: All-weather indoor walking track and community craft/music lounge right in the heart of Tampines.
places.why_zh: 全天候室内步道与社区手工音乐交谊廊，雨天或烟霾天也能安心活动。

places.name: Bedok Reservoir & Town Park Morning Brisk-Walk Loop
places.name_zh: 勿洛蓄水池公园晨运步道
places.why_en: Waterside morning walking loop popular with East-side qigong and brisk-walking groups.
places.why_zh: 勿洛水畔晨运步道，适合晴朗空气好时与街坊散步晨运。

places.name: Bugis & Heartland Mango Pomelo & Grapefruit Sago Dessert House
places.name_zh: 杨枝甘露与西柚西米露甜品铺
places.why_en: High Qloo taste affinity with traditional Nanyang café goers, but uses fresh grapefruit/pomelo pulp and heavy rock-sugar syrup.
places.why_zh: 虽在品味图谱上与传统茶座高度相关，但含新鲜西柚/柚子果肉及浓糖水。

places.name: Heritage Salted Fish & Heavy Soy Braised Claypot Rice Stall
places.name_zh: 传统咸鱼腊味重酱油砂煲饭档
places.why_en: Matched by Qloo's nostalgic hawker cluster, but relies on salted cured fish and high-sodium dark soy gravy.
places.why_zh: 虽属怀旧小贩美食聚类，但含高盐分咸鱼腊味及浓酱油卤汁。

places.name: Classic Extra-Sweet Rose Syrup Bandung & Condensed Milk Stall
places.name_zh: 传统特甜玫瑰露万隆冰与炼乳茶档
places.why_en: Matched by Qloo's heritage drink cluster, but prepared with heavy rose cordial syrup and sweetened condensed milk.
places.why_zh: 虽属传统饮品聚类，但使用大量玫瑰糖浆与甜炼乳。

artists.name: Teresa Teng (邓丽君) — 'The Moon Represents My Heart'
artists.name_zh: 邓丽君 —《月亮代表我的心》《甜蜜蜜》
artists.why_en: Top Qloo musical bridge across Singapore's Mandarin, Hokkien and Teochew senior communities.
artists.why_zh: Qloo 华语与闽潮长者群体中关联度最高的经典歌手。

artists.name: Fong Fei-Fei (凤飞飞) — 'Applause (掌声响起)'
artists.name_zh: 凤飞飞 —《掌声响起》《爱拼才会赢》时代金曲
artists.why_en: Strong Qloo cross-affinity with Hokkien/Teochew kopitiam culture and community sing-alongs.
artists.why_zh: 与本地咖啡店文化及社区歌唱班高度共鸣的闽台华语金曲。

artists.name: Frances Yip (叶丽仪) & Fei Yu-ching (费玉清)
artists.name_zh: 叶丽仪《上海滩》与费玉清《一剪梅》
artists.why_en: Favourite karaoke duet and solo repertoire at Active Ageing Centres across Singapore.
artists.why_zh: 活跃乐龄中心卡拉OK最受欢迎的粤语及华语长青金曲。

artists.name: Tan Sri P. Ramlee & Biduanita Saloma — 'Getaran Jiwa'
artists.name_zh: 比·南利与莎萝玛 —《Getaran Jiwa》马来黄金年代经典
artists.why_en: Qloo anchors Jalan Ampas golden-era Malay melodies directly to Nusantara warung and community radio tastes.
artists.why_zh: Qloo 将惹兰安拔士黄金年代马来金曲与本地传统咖啡店品味紧密相连。

artists.name: T.M. Soundararajan & P. Susheela — Golden Tamil Melodies
artists.name_zh: T.M. Soundararajan 与 P. Susheela — 泰米尔经典旋律
artists.why_en: High Qloo affinity with classic Tamil cinema music and morning brisk-walk radio listeners.
artists.why_zh: 与泰米尔经典电影音乐及晨运听众群体高度契合。

artists.name: Gurdas Maan & Surinder Kaur — Punjabi Folk Classics
artists.name_zh: Gurdas Maan 与 Surinder Kaur — 旁遮普民谣经典
artists.why_en: Qloo connects Punjabi folk and devotional melodies with community garden and family tea gatherings.
artists.why_zh: Qloo 将旁遮普传统民谣与社区园艺及茶叙品味相连。

artists.name: Cliff Richard & The Shadows — 1960s Rediffusion Oldies
artists.name_zh: Cliff Richard & The Shadows — 60年代丽的呼声英文怀旧金曲
artists.why_en: Loved by English-speaking Singapore seniors who grew up with 1960s Rediffusion and vinyl tea dances.
artists.why_zh: 深受听60年代丽的呼声长大的英语系长者喜爱。

movies.name: The Love Eterne (梁山伯与祝英台, 1963 Shaw Brothers)
movies.name_zh: 邵氏黄梅调经典《梁山伯与祝英台》(1963)
movies.why_en: Qloo cross-domain link: fans of 1970s Mandopop and community singing strongly favour Shaw Brothers Huangmei opera films.
movies.why_zh: Qloo 跨领域洞察：喜爱70年代华语金曲与歌唱的长者，对邵氏黄梅调电影有极高共鸣。

movies.name: Bujang Lapok (1957 Jalan Ampas Studio, Singapore)
movies.name_zh: 新加坡惹兰安拔士经典喜剧《Bujang Lapok》(1957)
movies.why_en: Filmed in Singapore's Jalan Ampas; Qloo's top nostalgia film match for P. Ramlee and Nusantara kopi culture.
movies.why_zh: 摄于新加坡惹兰安拔士，是 Qloo 为比·南利乐迷匹配的头号怀旧电影。

movies.name: Pasamalar (1961) & Karnan (1964) — Sivaji Ganesan Classics
movies.name_zh: 泰米尔影史经典《Pasamalar》(1961) 与《Karnan》(1964)
movies.why_en: Iconic 1960s Tamil cinema featuring T.M. Soundararajan and P. Susheela playback vocals.
movies.why_zh: 由 T.M. Soundararajan 与 P. Susheela 幕后献唱的60年代经典泰米尔电影。

movies.name: The Young Ones (1961) & Cathay-Keris Singapore Matinee Classics
movies.name_zh: 《The Young Ones》(1961) 与国泰克里斯怀旧早场电影
movies.why_en: Qloo connects 1960s English oldies and community craft circles with classic Cathay and Capitol cinema matinees.
movies.why_zh: Qloo 将60年代英文金曲与国泰戏院怀旧早场电影品味相连接。
